JDRNINJA.menu.name: JDR Ninja connections
JDRNINJA.menu.label: Configure connections
JDRNINJA.menu.hint: Connect this browser to your account and link this Foundry world to Atlas.
JDRNINJA.panel.title: JDR Ninja connections
JDRNINJA.panel.intro: Connect this browser to your JDR Ninja account. If you are a GM, you can also link this Foundry world to an Atlas world.
JDRNINJA.panel.draft: Configure Atlas and VTT Overlay. Each integration has its own enable option.
JDRNINJA.account.heading: JDR Ninja account
JDRNINJA.account.hint: This connection belongs to this browser. It is used for the VTT overlay and the D&D monster and NPC generators.
JDRNINJA.account.manualHint: You can also copy a token from the Foundry connection page on JDR Ninja.
JDRNINJA.account.disconnectHint: Disconnecting removes the token saved in this browser. To revoke it, open device management.
JDRNINJA.account.limited: The account is connected. Sending dice to the overlay requires a paid subscription.
JDRNINJA.atlas.heading: Atlas world
JDRNINJA.atlas.hint: Copy the token from your Atlas world settings or the Foundry Connections page on JDR Ninja. All GMs in this Foundry world will use this connection.
JDRNINJA.atlas.disconnectHint: Disconnecting removes the token from this Foundry world. To revoke it, open Foundry Connections on JDR Ninja.
JDRNINJA.atlas.limited: The world is connected. Atlas sync requires a subscription that permits it.
JDRNINJA.field.serverHint: Keep the default address to connect to JDR Ninja. Change it if you use a local installation.
JDRNINJA.pairing.instruction: Open JDR Ninja and approve the connection. If asked for a code, enter this one:
JDRNINJA.error.invalidOrigin: Enter the HTTPS site address without a path or parameters. Local HTTP addresses are also accepted.

JDRNINJA.error.invalidResponse: The site returned an unrecognized response. Check the address and try again.

JDRNINJA.error.denied: The connection was denied on JDR Ninja.
JDRNINJA.error.expired: The code expired. Start connecting again.
JDRNINJA.error.notGM: Only a GM can configure the Atlas connection.
JDRNINJA.error.saveFailed: The connection could not be saved. Try again.

JDRNINJA.overlay.title: VTT Overlay
JDRNINJA.overlay.intro: Send the exact results of public rolls to your OBS overlay. Configure your account connection in JDR Ninja connections.
JDRNINJA.overlay.enable: Enable VTT Overlay in this browser
JDRNINJA.overlay.enableHint: Public rolls at the table are sent to your overlay. This option applies to this browser. Connecting the account does not enable it automatically.
JDRNINJA.overlay.filterHint: Private, blind and whispered rolls are never forwarded.
JDRNINJA.overlay.holdHint: Delay the result card in this browser's chat. The delay starts when the roll is created. If Dice So Nice hides it for longer, its deadline applies.
JDRNINJA.overlay.tableCommandsHint: Twitch commands configured on JDR Ninja can draw from Foundry tables. Each draw creates a message in the world's chat. This option is off by default and requires a GM with VTT Overlay enabled in this browser.
JDRNINJA.overlay.tablesHint: Copy the table's Foundry UUID and paste it on JDR Ninja. Every die in its formula must be a d4, d6, d8, d10, d12 or d20.
JDRNINJA.overlay.paidHint: Connection and diagnostics are free. Sending rolls, including the test roll, requires a paid subscription.
JDRNINJA.overlay.testHint: The test sends a fixed d20 result of 20. It creates no Foundry chat roll.
JDRNINJA.overlay.testSent: Test roll accepted. Check your OBS overlay.
JDRNINJA.overlay.error.disabled: VTT Overlay is disabled in this browser.
JDRNINJA.overlay.error.legacyActive: The JDR Ninja VTT Overlay module is still active. Disable it to use the JDR Ninja integration.
JDRNINJA.overlay.error.unconfigured: Connect your account in JDR Ninja connections.
JDRNINJA.overlay.error.notEntitled: Sending rolls requires a paid subscription.

JDRNINJA.overlay.diag.pollMissing: No recent command poll by a browser.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.title: Stream Deck
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.enable: Enable Stream Deck in this browser
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.enableHint: Allow Stream Deck to run commands with your Foundry permissions. This option is off by default.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.intro: Connect this Foundry browser to Stream Deck. Available documents and game state are synchronized before commands can run.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.urlHint: Use a loopback address ending in /jdr-ninja. A Foundry page served over HTTPS may require wss and a trusted local certificate.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.keyHint: Use the same pairing key in Foundry and in the Stream Deck plugin. Keep your JDR Ninja account and Atlas credentials separate.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.generatedHint: Copy this new key into the local connection settings and the Stream Deck plugin, then save it here. It will no longer be displayed after saving.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.permissions: Commands use this browser's user permissions. A document UUID does not grant access to that document.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.companion: This module supplies the Foundry side of the connection. Start the local connection on this computer to link Stream Deck.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.invalidEndpoin: Use a local ws or wss address ending in /jdr-ninja.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.invalidKey: The pairing key must contain 32 to 128 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.secureContext: This browser cannot use secure authentication here. Open Foundry over HTTPS or a trusted local address.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.wrongSession: The Foundry session has changed. Reconnect.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.connectionFail: The local connection is unavailable. Check the connection address and start the local connection.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.handshakeTimeo: The local connection was not established in time.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.invalidMessage: A message from the local connection was not recognized.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.authentication: The pairing keys do not match, or the connection could not be verified.
Verify the connection before running commands.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.snapshotTooLar: The document list exceeds the connection's size limit.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.heartbeatTimeo: The local connection is no longer responding. Reconnect.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.saveFailed: The connection could not be saved.
JDRNINJA.streamDeck.error.syncTimeout: The local connection did not acknowledge synchronization in time.
JDRNINJA.variables.title: Variables and lists (advanced)
JDRNINJA.variables.menu.hint: Reuse values in commands and configure macro arguments.
JDRNINJA.variables.hint: Define reusable values without changing Foundry documents.
JDRNINJA.variables.name: Name
JDRNINJA.variables.clamp: Clamp increments and decrements to bounds
JDRNINJA.variables.expressionHint: Write a variable as @{Name}. For a document, add the path of its data as in an Active Effect: @{Spotlight hero}.system.attributes.inspiration. Use numbers, quoted text, true, false, arithmetic, comparisons, and min, max, clamp, round, floor, ceil, abs, if, concat.
JDRNINJA.variables.label: Label
JDRNINJA.variables.currentHint: Save changes the definition and default. To change the current value, choose an action below.
JDRNINJA.variables.externalReferences: Stream Deck buttons and other users' personal variables are not inventoried here.
JDRNINJA.variables.selectHint: Select a definition or create one.
JDRNINJA.variables.deleteEntry: Delete this entry? Selections using it will become unavailable.
JDRNINJA.variables.convert: Change the definition and replace its current value? Externally saved buttons may become incompatible.
JDRNINJA.variables.argumentDefaultHint: Enter a number, true or false, text or UUID matching the selected type.
JDRNINJA.variables.macroHint: Declare arguments for a script macro you can edit. Its script must consume them and acknowledge execution.
JDRNINJA.variables.macroAckHint: Read scope.jdrNinja.arguments in the macro. Return the acknowledgement after completing the action. The declaration does not change the script.
JDRNINJA.variables.disableMacroConfirm: Remove the argument declaration? Commands supplying arguments will become incompatible.
